name: smwmusic-zorp-s-last-voyage
title: Zorp's Last Voyage
description:
A dancey song with frantic drums and a sentimental melody. Would make decent credits music, or sky level music.

This is a cover of my and tesselode's original track Zorp's Last Voyage from our album Wigglin.

Incompatible with Blargg/Thunder/Firework.
